item.command:
/bin/bash -lc "cat > internal/storage/fs/oci/source_test.go <<'EOF'
package oci

import (
 \"bytes\"
 \"context\"
 \"path/filepath\"
 \"testing\"

 \"github.com/opencontainers/go-digest\"
 v1 \"github.com/opencontainers/image-spec/specs-go/v1\"
 \"github.com/stretchr/testify/require\"
 \"go.flipt.io/flipt/internal/config\"
 fliptoci \"go.flipt.io/flipt/internal/oci\"
 \"go.uber.org/zap\"
 \"oras.land/oras-go/v2\"
 layout \"oras.land/oras-go/v2/content/oci\"
)

func TestSourceLocalExternalUpdate(t *testing.T) {
 ctx := context.Background()
 dir := t.TempDir()
 repoDir := filepath.Join(dir, \"flags\")
 publish := func(key string) {
  t.Helper()
  // A separate OCI store simulates another process updating the layout.
  target, err := layout.New(repoDir)
  require.NoError(t, err)
  target.AutoSaveIndex = true
  payload := []byte(\"flags:\\n  - key: \" + key + \"\\n    name: \" + key + \"\\n    enabled: true\\n    type: BOOLEAN_FLAG_TYPE\\n\")
  layer := v1.Descriptor{Digest: digest.FromBytes(payload), Size: int64(len(payload)), MediaType: fliptoci.MediaTypeFliptFeatures + \"+yaml\", Annotations: map[string]string{fliptoci.AnnotationFliptNamespace: \"team\"}}
  require.NoError(t, target.Push(ctx, layer, bytes.NewReader(payload)))
  desc, err := oras.PackManifest(ctx, target, oras.PackManifestVersion1_1_RC4, fliptoci.MediaTypeFliptFeatures, oras.PackManifestOptions{ManifestAnnotations: map[string]string{}, Layers: []v1.Descriptor{layer}})
  require.NoError(t, err)
  require.NoError(t, target.Tag(ctx, desc, \"latest\"))
 }
 publish(\"first\")
 store, err := fliptoci.NewStore(&config.OCI{BundleDirectory: dir, Repository: \"flipt://local/flags:latest\"})
 require.NoError(t, err)
 source, err := NewSource(zap.NewNop(), store)
 require.NoError(t, err)
 first, err := source.Get(ctx)
 require.NoError(t, err)
 _, err = first.GetFlag(ctx, \"team\", \"first\")
 require.NoError(t, err)
 same, err := source.Get(ctx)
 require.NoError(t, err)
 require.Same(t, first, same)
 publish(\"second\")
 second, err := source.Get(ctx)
 require.NoError(t, err)
 require.NotSame(t, first, second)
 _, err = second.GetFlag(ctx, \"team\", \"second\")
 require.NoError(t, err)
}
EOF

item.text:
Added OCI-backed feature flag snapshots for local directories and remote registries. The new source caches snapshots by digest, reopens local OCI layouts on each fetch, and polls for changes. I also made `SnapshotSource.Get` context-aware, wired OCI into storage selection, and corrected the OCI config defaults.

Tests passed for `internal/config`, `internal/oci`, `internal/storage/fs/...`, and `internal/cmd`. The new regression test covers an external local OCI update and polling behavior.
